scope: B2 add+bias last-axis softmax; 2048x2048 FP32 plus contiguous length-2048 FP32 bias. Temporary diagnostic kernels and entry clones. Shipped v8 unchanged.
quartiles: Arrays of three numbers are median, 25th and 75th percentiles, in microseconds. Positive paired gain denotes a faster candidate.

shared_bias_requested_bytes.basis: 12 clusters and 64 cores per cluster. gm2sm transfers before/inside grid loop = 1/0; gm2lm = 0/1. Counts describe logical GM requests.

limitations: Timed XRE boundaries are host submission timestamps, not on-device start times. Interposition runs and normal latency trials are separate.

The steady-entry comparison alternates eager and public calls within a block with no per-call changes of wrapper. Each reported block median is based on 38 ordinary calls per path, across 21 retained blocks. Public host difference is sensitive to the interleaving protocol.

The earlier private multi-graph replay timed runs did not finish; no timing from those trials was used. Normal single calls and batches of 40 real public calls were verified; the combination is not cleared for graph replay.

The shared bias prototype is specialized to a full-width 2048-element tile. The available SDK rejected the 32-row shared layout on stack budget. Cross-core tree summation changes floating-point order.
Raw kernel comparisons use identical preallocated output and 48 launches per sample. They must not be added to independently timed host intervals.
